XGATE GLOBAL - API CONTEXT AND DOCUMENTATION FOR AI

Overview:
XGate Global is a payment platform API. It allows creating Cash-in (Deposits) and Cash-out (Withdrawals) flows in BRL via Pix, as well as buying and selling USDT/USDC using BRL balance, with direct delivery to or receiving from the company's wallet. It offers sub-account management, balance control, webhooks, and real-time quotes. Old crypto routes (conversion on deposit/withdrawal, crypto withdrawals, and customer wallets) stop working on 2026-10-29 and respond with 410 FEATURE_DISCONTINUED. The entire API uses REST + JSON with Bearer Token authentication.

API Base URL: https://api.xgateglobal.com/

Important Notes:
- Authentication: all requests require the header Authorization: Bearer <your-jwt-token>.
- Currencies: BRL (via Pix). Crypto via the Buy & Sell API: USDT on POLYGON, ETHEREUM, TRON, and SOLANA; USDC on POLYGON, ETHEREUM, and SOLANA.
- Crypto API (/crypto/*): monetary values always formatted as decimal strings ("1500.00"); error envelope { reason, message, traceId }; requires IP allowlist; purchase idempotency via externalId.
- Customers: Unique by tax/national document (CPF/CNPJ). Use customerId (existing) or the customer object (on-the-fly creation) in deposit orders. Never send both.
- Idempotency: Use externalId across all financial transactions to prevent duplicate operations.
- Webhooks: Notifications sent via POST. Crypto events use envelope { id, type, createdAt, data } with transaction summary data. Always validate origin IP and use resend endpoints if reception fails.
- Balances: After 2026-10-29, companies hold balances in BRL only; purchased crypto goes directly to the company wallet and crypto sales settle into BRL balance or via Pix.

Authentication
- POST /auth/token: Generates the JWT token. Required: email, password. Validity: 15 days.

Customers
- POST /customer: Creates a customer. Required: name, document.
- GET /customer/{id}: Retrieves full customer details by ID.
- PUT /customer/{id}: Updates customer profile information.

Pix Keys
- POST /pix/customer/{clientId}/key: Registers a new Pix key (CPF, CNPJ, EMAIL, PHONE, RANDOM).
- GET /pix/customer/{clientId}/key: Lists active Pix keys for a customer.
- DELETE /pix/customer/{clientId}/key/remove/{keyId}: Deletes a Pix key.

Deposits (Cash-in)
- POST /deposit: Creates a Pix deposit intent. Returns QR Code copy-and-paste payload (code).
  - Fiat -> Fiat: Requires currency object (BRL).
  - Fiat -> Crypto (discontinued on 2026-10-29): Requires currency (BRL) and cryptocurrency (USDT) objects.
- GET /crypto/customer/{clientId}/wallet (discontinued on 2026-10-29): Returns fixed publicKey address for direct USDT deposits.

Withdrawals (Cash-out)
- POST /withdraw: Processes withdrawals. Initial status: PENDING.
  - Fiat -> Fiat: Pix withdrawal. Requires pixKey object.
  - Crypto -> Fiat (discontinued on 2026-10-29): Converts USDT to BRL and sends via Pix.
  - Crypto -> Wallet (discontinued on 2026-10-29): Sends funds to an external wallet.

Crypto Buy and Sell
- Overview: Buy and sell USDT/USDC using BRL balance; supported assets and networks.
- Conventions: Authentication, allowed IPs, CRYPTO.VIEW and CRYPTO.EXECUTE permissions, string values, errors, cursor-based pagination, limits.
- GET /crypto/options: Assets, networks, fees, purchase limits, saved addresses, and deposit addresses for sales.
- POST /crypto/quotes and POST /crypto/quotes/estimate: Quote with quoteId (valid for 30s) or estimate without price lock. Body: asset, network, amount (BRL string).
- POST /crypto/purchases: Buy using quoteId or at market price (asset, network, amount). Required: externalId and address or addressId.
- GET /crypto/purchases and GET /crypto/purchases/{id}: Paginated list and purchase query.
- GET /crypto/purchases/{id}/receipt: HTML receipt for DELIVERED purchase.
- Sell Crypto: Send USDT/USDC to the company's fixed address (sale.depositAddresses[]). Each confirmed on-chain transfer automatically triggers a sale settled into BRL balance or via Pix.
- GET /crypto/sales/{id}: Retrieves full details of a sale.
- Error Codes: Reasons by HTTP status and purchase rejection reasons.

Company and Sub-accounts
- GET /company/balance: Checks available balances (BRL) of the master account.
- POST /company/sub-account: Creates and manages sub-accounts for balance isolation.
- POST /company/sub-account/webhook: Sets dedicated webhook URL for sub-accounts.
- POST /company/sub-account/ip: Configures IP allowlist for transactions via sub-account.

Webhooks
- Receiving Webhooks: Overview of notification delivery, official static IP (107.23.39.46), and standard payload.
- Crypto Purchase Webhook (CRYPTO_PURCHASE): purchase.* events with purchase summary.
- Crypto Sale Webhook (CRYPTO_SALE): sale.* events with sale summary.
- POST /webhooks/withdraw/resend: Triggers resending a withdrawal notification by transaction ID.
- POST /webhooks/deposit/resend: Triggers resending a deposit notification by transaction ID.

Quotes and Support
- GET /deposit/company/currencies: Lists supported fiat currencies.
- GET /withdraw/company/blockchain-networks: Lists networks and network fees.
- POST /withdraw/transaction/crypto/amount: Simulates net crypto withdrawal amount after network fees.
